Nature_Physics.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon
Nature_Physics.summary: Electrons on the surface of solid neon have been established as high-quality individual qubits. Now two-qubit gates have been demonstrated using the strong coupling between electrons confined in close proximity to each other.

Nature_Physics.title: Supersolid crystals of dipolar excitons in a lattice
Nature_Physics.summary: Supersolids have previously been observed in weakly interacting scenarios. Now several supersolid phases are demonstrated in a strongly correlated system of dipolar excitons confined to a lattice with long-range hopping.

Nature_Physics.title: Rich quantum phase diagram revealed in semimetallic rhombohedral graphene
Nature_Physics.summary: Previous studies of rhombohedral graphene have focused on a single topological and flat conduction or valence band isolated by strong electric fields. Rhombohedral hexalayer graphene is now found to host various quantum phenomena in the correlated semimetallic regime, featuring symmetry breaking, electric-field-driven band inversion, dual-carrier superconductivity and ferroelectric orbital magnetism.

Nature_Physics.title: 150 years proving fundamental science is worth the wait
Nature_Physics.summary: Founded in 1876, the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science created an early space for Indians to pursue science. Its achievements offer valuable lessons for strengthening today’s research landscape in India.

Nature_Physics.title: Extension of coherence time beyond breakeven point using only drives and dissipation
Nature_Physics.summary: An autonomous quantum error correction protocol based on engineered drives and dissipation extends the coherence time of a bosonic logical qubit beyond that of the best physical qubit in the same system.

Nature_Physics.title: Extending qubit lifetime beyond break-even and enhancing quantum sensing by autonomous quantum error correction
Nature_Physics.summary: A measurement-free quantum error-correction protocol is shown to extend the lifetime of a bosonic logical qubit beyond the best physical qubit in the same system. This also offers prospects for enhanced quantum sensing.

Nature_Materials.title: Tunable diffusive memristor arrays for neuromorphic temporal computing
Nature_Materials.summary: Scaling diffusive memristors from single devices to integrated systems has been hindered by stochastic ionic motion and filament evolution. Here confined metal-ion migration enables controlled relaxation dynamics, as demonstrated in a 28 × 14 array for neuromorphic computing.

Nature_Materials.title: Proximal single atoms for stable electrocatalysts
Nature_Materials.summary: Ru–O–Cr motifs atomically dispersed in proximity on a MnO2 substrate effectively suppress oxidation-induced Ru dissolution with enhanced catalyst durability towards the oxygen evolution reaction in acidic water electrolysers.

Nature_Materials.title: A funder for Europe
Nature_Materials.summary: As the European Research Council approaches renewal, we look at where European funding for science currently stands.

Nature_Materials.title: Encoding information into an embroidery of topological defects in liquid crystals
Nature_Materials.summary: A photopatterned alignment layer with a periodic lattice of vortices acts as a substrate for pinned defect lines in a liquid crystal. These topological defect lines can be rearranged by optical manipulation into a vast number of states that can store information.

Nature_Materials.title: The person behind the scientist
Nature_Materials.summary: Matteo Seita and Mengying Liu discuss their reflections as organizers of The Past Metallurgists Society lecture series, where scientists meet to share stories of distinguished metallurgists from the past.

Nature_Materials.title: Nanostructures strengthen titanium alloys
Nature_Materials.summary: Machine learning guides the design of an additively manufactured titanium alloy containing superfine features at the 10 nm scale through controlled martensitic transformation, which achieves an ultimate tensile strength of more than 1.7 GPa and 7.5% uniform elongation.

Nature_Materials.title: High-loading all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries enabled by tailored sulfur–sulfide and sulfur–carbon interfaces
Nature_Materials.summary: All-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries are a next-generation high-energy-density solution for energy storage. Here catholyte/cathode interfaces are found to be as important as transport tortuosity in thick sulfur cathodes, and an areal capacity of 10 mAh cm−2 is demonstrated at a stack pressure of 15 MPa and sulfur loading of 6.1 mg cm−2.

Nature_Communications.title: Anyone can be the best depending on how structural variant callers are evaluated
Nature_Communications.summary: An evaluation of long-read structural variant detection methods shows that reported performance can depend strongly on how they are evaluated, highlighting the need for more consistent benchmarking practices.

Nature_Communications.title: Control of out-of-plane anti-damping spin torque with a canted ferromagnetic spin source
Nature_Communications.summary: Huang et al. show that canted magnetization in SrRuO3 generates a sizable out-of-plane damping-like torque without relying on low crystal symmetry, offering a strategy toward scalable magnetic-memory devices with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy.

Nature_Communications.title: Rigidity-driven molecular assembly for high-efficiency flexible perovskite/CIGS tandems
Nature_Communications.summary: Flexible perovskite and copper indium gallium selenide tandem solar cells are hindered by rough interfaces that reduce efficiency and stability. Yao et al. designed a rigid molecular contact enabling efficient, durable devices that withstand prolonged operation and bending.

Nature_Communications.title: Room-temperature continuous-wave mid-infrared microdisk laser on InP enabled by InAs quantum dots
Nature_Communications.summary: Room temperature operation of microscale lasers in the short-wave mid-infrared has remained a longstanding challenge. Here, the authors demonstrate room temperature continuous wave lasing at 2.06 μm from a self-assembled InAs/InP quantum dot microdisk, enabled by strong carrier localization that overcomes key limitations of conventional quantum-well devices.

Nature_Communications.title: The human hypothalamus encodes prediction errors during sensory–nutrient inference
Nature_Communications.summary: How neural circuits compute nutrient content from sensory cues is not fully understood. This study shows that oral texture shapes how people judge the fat content of foods and identifies hypothalamic signals when texture and fat content mismatch, linking these neural signals to fat intake.

Nature_Communications.title: Buried stochastic interfaces enabling depth-multiplexed optical physical unclonable functions
Nature_Communications.summary: Optical physical unclonable functions often rely on surface-accessible features. Here, the authors conceal stochastic nanotexture at vertically stacked silicon interfaces beneath a planarized surface and use depth-selective optical gating to read eight planes for reliable hardware authentication.
